pins.name: VDDIO
pins.net: +3V3_SENS (I2C level select; <0.7 V also means VDD level)

circuit.role: SHT40 on controller port, no extra pull-ups (10k inside the STCC4)

circuit.page: p6 fig 1; value from bus capacitance

supplies.ripple: <=30 mV pp unloaded: Sensirion suggests an LDO if the rail is noisy (design-in guide p4)

logic: I2C level = VDDIO pin (1.8 V..VDD), sampled at power-up; VDDIO < 0.7 V selects VDD. 3.3 V bus direct. Up to 1 MHz (p4-6)
placement: Shared gas vent. At least 1 mm between the sensor membrane and the housing (design-in guide p3, guideline 5).
Vent as a grill of several small openings rather than one big hole; avoid direct breath/fan bursts (guide p3).
Far from heat (brain, charger, 3.3 V converter, e-paper front light); milled slots and narrow traces around it (guide p2).
SHT40 in the same local air as the STCC4 (guide p2/p4).
Membrane must not be touched, wetted or washed: no board wash after reflow; fit in the last reflow pass; not vapour phase (ds p16).
Operating conditions for the stated accuracy: 10-40 C, 20-80 %RH (ds p4).
notes: SHT4x hosting (ds p6, guide p4): the STCC4 has its own I2C controller pads SDA_C/SCL_C with 10k internal pull-ups; an SHT4x with address 0x44 ONLY is wired there and the STCC4 reads it itself for compensation. The SHT40 is then NOT on the brain's bus: T and RH come back in the STCC4's read_measurement data (conversion formulas ds p14).
Alternative: SHT4x on the brain's bus and the brain sends RH/T every 1 s with set_rht_compensation (ds p10). Not needed.
If SDA_C/SCL_C are unused they must go to floating pads (ds p5 note 8).
Pressure compensation: feed the BMP581 reading with set_pressure_compensation (ds p4, guide p4).
Sleep 1 uA by command (enter_sleep_mode 0x3650); wake = address + write + one 0x00 byte that is not acknowledged (ds p11). No switched rail needed.
JLCPCB lists no datasheet for C49191471; read from sensirion.com/resource/datasheet/STCC4 (D1 v1, June 2025).
